detail.contextTitle: An independent project, not a client engagement.

comptaclems.title: Comptaclems
comptaclems.summary: Comptaclems is an independent web platform designed to simplify the processing and preparation of tax returns for individuals, self-employed workers, and small and medium-sized businesses. It centralizes client, tax document, and file management to give accounting professionals a structured, secure, and efficient environment to track every engagement from intake to completion.
comptaclems.description: ComptaClems structures three spaces — public, client, admin — to reduce manual email exchanges and give clear tracking of accounting files, tax filings, and administrative requests.
challenge: Centralize exchanges currently scattered across email and paper documents.
Clearly separate the client space from the administrator space.
Design a data structure suited to real accounting services (bookkeeping, GST/QST, payroll).
approach: Mapped accounting services before designing the screens.
Strict role separation: public, authenticated client, administrator.
PostgreSQL database designed around files, documents, and processing statuses.
limitations: In active development: several planned features are still being built.
No accounting firm is using the platform in production yet.
Security and compliance still need validation before handling real tax data.

seo.title: ComptaClems — accounting management platform
seo.description: Independent web platform project for accounting firms to manage clients, documents, and tax filings.

bilikFarm.title: Bilik Farm
bilikFarm.category: Showcase website for an integrated farm
bilikFarm.summary: Bilik Farm is a professional showcase website designed to present and highlight the activities of an integrated farm combining crop and livestock operations. The platform also includes management features to centralize certain information related to farm operations, contacts, and administrative tracking.
bilikFarm.description: Bilik Farm pairs a public showcase of the farm (activities, products, vision) with an internal CRM to track crops, animals, sales, inventory, and clients.
challenge: Present a farm with multiple activities (crops and livestock) clearly.
Bring sales, inventory, and client tracking into a single tool.
Separate the public showcase from internal operational management.
approach: Public site kept separate from the CRM, with authentication for the internal space.
Dashboard focused on tracking crops, animals, and sales.
Modular Next.js architecture to add management modules progressively.
limitations: Independent project: no farm currently uses it in production.
Internal reports and indicators still need validation with real usage.
No real sales or profitability data integrated.

seo.title: Bilik Farm — farm website and CRM
seo.description: Independent showcase website and CRM project for an integrated crop and livestock farm.

cosmechic.title: Cosmechic
cosmechic.summary: Cosmechic is an online store specializing in cosmetic products for Afro, Black, and mixed-heritage skin and hair. The platform offers a modern shopping experience for discovering, searching, and ordering products suited to its customers' specific needs, including facial care, body care, hair care, and beauty.
cosmechic.description: Cosmechic presents a cosmetics catalog and order/client management, with a mobile-first interface built for this specific market.
challenge: Structure a catalog by category and care type.
Keep the purchase journey simple on mobile.
Plan for order and inventory management on the admin side.
approach: Catalog and product pages organized by need (skin, hair, routine).
Cart-to-checkout flow designed for mostly mobile usage.
Separate admin space for order and catalog tracking.
limitations: Independent project, not yet operating as a commercial store.
Online payment and real logistics not deployed in production.
No real sales volume or clients.

seo.title: Cosmechic — e-commerce store
seo.description: Independent e-commerce store project for cosmetic products for Afro skin and hair.

biketrip.title: BikeTrip
biketrip.summary: BikeTrip is a mobile app designed to help cyclists prepare for and track their bike rides. It centralizes useful information such as bike paths, weather conditions, certain safety settings, and activity tracking to help users plan their routes and enjoy their rides under better conditions.
biketrip.description: BikeTrip helps cyclists discover routes, track their rides, and share community reports, with a Supabase backend and automated test coverage.
challenge: Bring route discovery, weather, and safety into a single app.
Ensure reliable ride data (distance, speed, elevation).
Secure user data with strict access rules.
approach: React Native + Expo architecture with file-based routing.
Supabase backend with Row Level Security (RLS) for data isolation.
Unit test suite (Jest) and GitHub Actions continuous integration.
limitations: GPS statistics not yet validated on a physical device under real conditions.
Offline mode and background GPS tracking not yet delivered.
App not yet published on app stores (EAS Build still pending).

seo.title: BikeTrip — mobile app for cyclists
seo.description: Independent React Native mobile app project to plan and track bike rides.

eduquiz.title: EduQuiz
eduquiz.summary: EduQuiz is a bilingual French-English education platform for Quebec students, from grade 3 of elementary school through grade 11 (secondary 5). It lets students practice through quizzes, exercises, and learning activities adapted to their grade level, while supporting review, self-directed learning, and reinforcement of what they learn in class.
eduquiz.description: EduQuiz aims to help students learn, review, and practice their lessons with quizzes adapted to their level, on a complete technical foundation (monorepo, authentication, Quebec privacy-law compliance).
challenge: Build a bilingual showcase covering 10 subjects and 9 grade levels.
Secure authentication and data for underage students.
Plan for compliance from the start (data export, account deletion).
approach: Turborepo/pnpm monorepo with shared packages (UI, database, auth, i18n).
Auth.js authentication with Argon2id hashing and Redis rate limiting.
Audit logging and health checks for application reliability.
limitations: Quiz engine and learning progression not yet delivered.
Parent dashboard and full minor-user flow not complete.
Actively in development; phase 1 partially delivered.

seo.title: EduQuiz — bilingual education platform
seo.description: Independent bilingual education platform project for Quebec students, built as a Next.js monorepo.

forumSportif.title: Forum Sportif
forumSportif.summary: Forum Sportif is a community platform designed to bring sports enthusiasts together around a space for discussion and discovery. Users can discuss sports news, share their opinions, take part in themed conversations, and use geolocation to discover nearby places to practice different sports.
forumSportif.description: Forum Sportif combines a discussion forum, location search by sport, and an interactive map to help people discover fields, gyms, clubs, and sports spaces nearby.
challenge: Combine geolocated search and community discussion in one product.
Structure sports categories and user profiles.
Allow reviews and reports on listed venues.
approach: Interactive map paired with search by sport and area.
Forum organized by sports categories with posts and comments.
User profiles and a venue review system.
limitations: Independent project, no active community deployed yet.
Moderation and reviews need a framework before real public use.
Geographic coverage and venue data not field-validated.

seo.title: Forum Sportif — geolocated community platform
seo.description: Independent geolocated sports forum project to find venues and connect with other enthusiasts.

garageAutoGonzague.title: Garage Auto Gonzague
garageAutoGonzague.category: Professional website for an auto garage
garageAutoGonzague.summary: Garage Auto Gonzague is a showcase website designed to present the services, expertise, and practical information of an auto repair shop. The platform also includes management features that help facilitate appointment requests, customer tracking, and the organization of certain administrative operations for the garage.
garageAutoGonzague.description: Garage Auto Gonzague combines a public site and an admin workspace for an auto garage: appointment management, tax-compliant invoicing, and automated customer communications.
challenge: Combine a public showcase and operational garage management in a single application.
Generate invoices compliant with Quebec sales taxes (GST 5%, QST 9.975%).
Automate appointment reminders by SMS and email.
approach: Next.js architecture with separate public and admin zones, NextAuth authentication.
PostgreSQL database via Prisma for customer, vehicle, and appointment records.
SMS (Vonage) and email (Resend) integrations for notifications, calendar (react-big-calendar) for scheduling.
limitations: Independent reference demonstrator: no confirmed production deployment for a real garage to date.
Real appointment and invoicing volumes not validated under real conditions.

seo.title: Garage Auto Gonzague — CRM and showcase site for an auto garage
seo.description: Independent CRM and showcase site project for an auto garage, with GST/QST invoicing and appointment booking.

logigest.title: Logigest
logigest.summary: Logigest is a SaaS solution designed to help farmers and livestock keepers in sub-Saharan Africa manage their operations day to day. The platform centralizes tracking of animals, farm plots, inventory, expenses, revenue, and various operations to improve organization, traceability, and decision-making.
logigest.description: Logigest aims to give farm operators a complete management tool usable offline, with automatic synchronization as soon as a connection becomes available again.
challenge: Work reliably on entry-level Android phones without a stable internet connection.
Synchronize local data with the server without loss or conflict when coming back online.
Adapt the interface and flows for users with limited digital familiarity.
approach: Offline local storage with Dexie.js and synchronization to Supabase PostgreSQL (RLS).
Next.js (App Router) monorepo with pnpm and Turborepo, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui interface.
Supabase Auth authentication, state management with Zustand and TanStack Query, internationalization via next-intl.
limitations: Project in development: MVP under construction, no farm client uses it in production to date.
Large-scale offline synchronization not yet validated in the field.

seo.title: Logigest — offline agricultural management SaaS
seo.description: Independent offline-first SaaS project for agricultural and livestock management in sub-Saharan Africa.

paroisseHub.title: ParoisseHub
paroisseHub.category: Digital platform for Quebec dioceses and parishes
paroisseHub.summary: ParoisseHub is a Christian community platform designed to modernize how Quebec dioceses, parishes, and churches share and provide access to their information. It lets religious communities publish and keep their information up to date, while worshippers can easily search for places of worship and check schedules, events, and useful information from a centralized, accessible platform.
paroisseHub.description: ParoisseHub (paroissehub.ca) centralizes parish and diocese information for the public. Developed in collaboration with Infotechs Solutions, with ongoing compliance work and data enrichment by diocese.
challenge: Centralize parish information scattered across multiple sources and dioceses.
Bring the platform into compliance with Quebec’s Law 25 on personal information protection.
Improve the reliability of published data, diocese by diocese.
approach: Next.js application with a PostgreSQL database via Prisma.
Automated testing (Vitest, Playwright) and continuous integration.
Ongoing audit and data-enrichment work, diocese by diocese, in a research environment before any production write.
limitations: Law 25 compliance and diocese data enrichment ongoing, not yet finalized for all of Quebec.
Exact commercial status (client mandate vs. collaboration) to be confirmed before broader public communication.

seo.title: ParoisseHub — platform for parishes and dioceses
seo.description: Independent community platform project for Quebec parishes and dioceses, developed in collaboration with Infotechs Solutions.

slgTech.title: SLG TECH
slgTech.summary: SLG TECH is an online store specializing in the sale of computer hardware, equipment, and accessories. The platform lets users browse different product categories, review their specifications, and complete their purchases through a modern, clear e-commerce experience suited to both individuals and professionals.
slgTech.description: SLG TECH is a Node.js e-commerce store with session-based authentication, Stripe payment, and an admin CRM to manage catalog, orders, reviews, and statistics.
challenge: Offer a complete purchase journey (catalog, cart, payment) for electronic products.
Give the team an admin panel to manage products, orders, customers, and reviews.
Secure online authentication and payment.
approach: Node.js/Express backend with dedicated routes (authentication, products, orders, customers, reviews, statistics).
Session-based authentication with bcrypt hashing and JWT tokens.
Stripe integration for payment and Nodemailer for transactional emails.
limitations: Data storage layer (JSON files vs. MySQL database, both present in the code) to be clarified.
Independent project: no store commercialized to date, no real sales volume.

seo.title: SLG TECH — online electronics store
seo.description: Independent e-commerce project for an electronics store with admin panel.

weatherWise.title: WeatherWise
weatherWise.summary: WeatherWise is a weather web application that lets users quickly check current weather conditions for a searched city or their geographic location. It provides detailed information such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, and sunrise and sunset times, for a clear and accessible view of local weather conditions.
weatherWise.description: WeatherWise queries the OpenWeatherMap API to display current weather conditions for a searched city or the user’s location, with a season estimate based on temperature.
challenge: Display reliable weather conditions from a city search or browser geolocation.
Present complete data (feels-like temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, visibility, sunrise/sunset) in a readable way.
approach: Flask (Python) backend exposing an endpoint that queries the OpenWeatherMap API.
JavaScript frontend using browser geolocation with a fallback to manual city search.
limitations: Displays only current conditions; no multi-day forecast confirmed in the current code.
Independent project, small-scale demonstration application.

seo.title: WeatherWise — weather application
seo.description: Independent weather application project displaying current conditions by city or geolocation.
